title: Forbidden subgraphs in divisor graphs and an Erdős divisibility problem
summary: Erdős asked for the largest size $f(n)$ of a subset of $\{1,\dots,n\}$ with no element dividing two others. We show that $f(n)=c_2\,n+o(n)$ for an effectively computable constant $c_2$, and moreover that the number $q(n)$ of such subsets satisfies $q(n)=β_2^{n+o(n)}$ for a computable constant $β_2$.
